feast.note: saint.gr's page for the two adds «Η μνήμη τους επαναλαμβάνεται στις 25 Οκτωβρίου» — their memory is repeated on 25 October (https://www.saint.gr/532/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026). The 25 October Greek day page was not read, and the day recorded here is the day page that was.
